body:
Various styles and types of textiles can be used in art. In textile art, blue jeans, not water paints, can be used to draw pictures. Beautiful threads replace photos of scenic views. These types of textiles can be brilliant tools for expanding artistic creativity.
Ian Berry, Denim Art
Have you ever imagined painting with clothes, not on clothes? Surprisingly, Ian Berry succeeded in this and makes art out of blue jeans. His art looks like a painting, but people suddenly notice the beauty in blue jeans when they look at his art. He collects denim of every shade and uses it to create the shading and the sense of perspective in his portraits, landscapes, and other unique works of art. With just his hands, scissors, and glue, he creates almost three-dimensional pieces. He has been making realistic installations of denim for many years. He uses discarded jeans, cuts them up into pieces, and, like a painter, sorts them according to color. At first glance, the work seems flat, but a closer look reveals different layers of denim placed on top of and over each other. They are in fact denim collages. They are almost impossible to distinguish from paintings.
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: Ian Berry creates artworks by using blue jeans instead of traditional art materials.
Berry gathers denim in different shades to create shading and perspective in his artworks.
Berry uses his hands, scissors, and glue to create almost three-dimensional pieces.
Berry cuts used jeans into pieces and arranges them by color like a painter.
Berry's denim collages have different layers, and they can be easily distinguished from paintings.
solution:
Berry의 작품에는 서로 겹쳐진 다른 층의 데님이 드러나는데, 그것들은 실제로 데님 콜라주이며, 그림과 구별하기가 거의 불가능하다고 했으므로 ⑤ ‘Berry의 데님 콜라주에는 서로 다른 층이 있으며, 그것들은 그림과 쉽게 구별될 수 있다.’는 일치하지 않는 내용이다.
오답
① Ian Berry는 전통적인 미술 재료 대신 청바지를 사용하여 작품을 만든다.
② Berry는 자신의 작품에서 명암과 원근감을 만들어 내기 위해 다양한 색조의 데님을 모은다.
③ Berry는 거의 입체적인 작품을 만들기 위해 자신의 손, 가위, 그리고 접착제를 사용한다.
④ Berry는 사용된 청바지를 조각으로 자르고 화가처럼 색깔에 따라 배열한다.

body:
It is said that silk production began with the most Chinese of things: tea. Leizu, the young wife of the Yellow Emperor, was sitting under a tree, with a cup of tea in her hand. A cocoon fell from one of the branches directly into the cup. (A) Naturally, she fished the offending object out, and to her amazement, she found that the tea had dissolved the coating of the cocoon. (B) What she held was a little lump of soft fibers. (C) Leizu unraveled it until it stretched from end to end of her garden, over 600 meters. (D) The result was a soft and shiny fabric that was cool to the touch. (E) This Chinese legend is only one of many woven around the production of silk.
For a long time, silk was a material reserved for the Emperor and those very close to him. Gradually, ㉠비단을 입고 사용할 수 있는 사람에 대한 제한이 느슨해졌고, 점점 더 많은 사람들이 비단옷을 입고 집을 비단 장식으로 꾸미는 것이 보이게 되었다. Eventually, silk production grew to become quite a large industry in China.
Silk became a valuable commodity highly sought after by other countries at a very early time, and it is believed that the silk trade was actually started before the Silk Road was officially opened in the second century B.C. The threads of silk found in the hair of an Egyptian mummy from around 1070 B.C. are probably the earliest evidence of the silk trade. The Silk Road significantly shaped the societies and cultures of the regions that it connected. Not only silk, but spices, rare metals, and exotic animals were also exchanged on the road. Religions, artistic styles, and technologies were shared as well, prompting the development of the civilizations.
윗글의 (A)~(E) 중, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은?
Intrigued, she gathered more cocoons from the tree to unravel, and worked the threads into cloth.
solution: 주어진 문장은 ‘호기심이 동한 그녀는 고치를 풀기 위해 나무에서 더 가져와 실로 옷감을 만들었다’는 뜻으로, 문장의 맨 앞에 Intrigued가 쓰였으므로 이 문장 앞에는 그녀가 호기심을 갖게 된 계기가 제시되어야 한다. 또한 more cocoons(더 많은 고치들)라는 표현을 통해 이미 고치 하나를 가지고 무언가를 해 본 내용이 앞에 제시되어 있음을 알 수 있다. 따라서 차가 고치의 막을 녹인 뒤에 남은 부드러운 섬유 덩어리를 발견한 뒤, 그 고치를 풀어 600m가 넘게 늘어뜨린 내용 이후인 (D)에서, 호기심이 생겨 더 많은 고치를 모아 풀고 그 실로 천을 만들었다는 주어진 문장이 연결된다. 또한 (D) 뒤에서 The result(그 결과)가 쓰여, 고치를 더 가져와 풀고 그 실로 옷감을 만든 결과를 가리키고 있으므로 그 앞에 주어진 문장이 들어가야 자연스럽게 이어지므로, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은 (D)이다.

It remains the most complex space suit to have been used to date, and it was the fruit of the ⓔcraftsmanship of the women skilled in sewing and making underwear, rather than NASA’s technological expertise.
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ의 영영풀이로 알맞은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
<보기>
ⓐ present: to offer your thoughts, ideas, plans, etc., to others for them to consider
ⓑ owe: to need to pay or give something to someone because they have lent money to you, or in exchange for something they have done for you
ⓒ flexible: able to bend or be bent easily without breaking
ⓓ component: the center or most important part of something
ⓔ craftsmanship: skill at making things, or the skill with which something was made or done
solution:
ⓐ ~을 제시하다: 다른 사람들이 그것을 고려하도록 자신의 생각, 아이디어, 계획 등을 그들에게 제안하다
ⓒ 유연한: 부러지지 않고 쉽게 구부리거나 구부러질 수 있는
ⓔ 솜씨: 무언가를 만드는 기술, 또는 무언가가 만들어지거나 행해진 방식의 기술
오답
ⓑ …은 ~ 덕분이다: 누군가가 당신에게 돈을 빌려주었기 때문에, 또는 그들이 당신을 위해 한 일에 대한 대가로, 그 사람에게 무언가를 지불하거나 주어야 하다
(→to have something or achieve something because of what someone else has done 다른 사람이 한 일 때문에 무언가를 가지거나 무언가를 성취하다)
ⓓ 구성 요소: 어떤 것의 중심이 되거나 또는 가장 중요한 부분
(→a part that combines with other parts to form something bigger 다른 부분들과 결합하여 더 큰 것을 형성하는 부분)

body:
Cloth That Connected the Worlds
It is said that silk production began with the most Chinese of things: tea. Leizu, the young wife of the Yellow Emperor, was sitting under a tree, with a cup of tea in her hand. A cocoon fell from one of the branches directly into the cup. Naturally, she fished the offending object out, and to her amazement, she found that the tea had dissolved the coating of the cocoon. What she held was a little lump of soft fibers. Leizu unraveled it until it stretched from end to end of her garden, over 600 meters. (A)[Intrigued / Intriguing], she gathered more cocoons from the tree to unravel, and worked the threads into cloth. The result was a soft and shiny fabric that was cool to the touch. This Chinese legend is only one of many (B)[weave / woven] around the production of silk.
For a long time, silk was a material reserved for the Emperor and those very close to him. Gradually, ⓐ______, and more and more people could be seen to wear silk clothing and (C)[to dress / dressing] up their homes with silk decorations. Eventually, silk production grew to become quite a large industry in China.
Silk became a valuable commodity highly sought after by other countries at a very early time, and it is believed that the silk trade was actually started before the Silk Road was officially opened in the second century B.C. The threads of silk found in the hair of an Egyptian mummy from around 1070 B.C. are probably the earliest evidence of the silk trade. The Silk Road significantly shaped the societies and cultures of the regions that it connected. Not only silk, but spices, rare metals, and exotic animals were also exchanged on the road. Religions, artistic styles, and technologies were shared as well, prompting the development of the civilizations.
윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: Intriguing weave to dress
Intrigued woven dressing
Intrigued woven to dress
Intrigued weave dressing
Intriguing woven to dress
solution:
(A) 콤마(,) 뒤의 완전한 절(she ~ cloth)과 접속사 없이 이어지므로 분사구문을 이루는 분사 자리이며, 의미상 주어 she가 ‘호기심을 갖게 된’ 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 갖는 과거분사 intrigued가 적절하다.
(B) 대명사 many를 수식하는 분사 자리이며, many가 ‘엮어 만들어진’ 대상이므로 수동의 의미를 갖는 과거분사 woven이 적절하다.
(C) 동사 see의 5형식 구문 ‘see+목적어+목적격보어(동사원형)’을 수동태로 전환되면 ‘목적어+be seen+to부정사(+by+주어)’의 형태가 된다. 따라서 be seen 뒤에 to wear가 쓰였고, to wear와 등위접속사 and로 병렬 연결되므로 to dress가 적절하다.

body:
Teresa Lim, Embroidery Art
People usually take pictures of scenic views, but Teresa Lim paints pictures of tourist spots with a needle and thread when she travels the world. She embroiders places she visits in surprising detail. This method of preserving memories lets her truly take in her surroundings. She spends time sitting in one place, observing details and stitching as the scene reveals itself. She says on her website that her designs “seek to erase the lines and boundaries between being an illustrator and a textile designer.” Her art is a delightful fusion of a canvas and a camera that projects travel scenes onto fabric. She recreates what she sees on cloth and eliminates the need for a vacation photo album.
다음 글을 아래와 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 연결된 것은?
Teresa Lim uniquely preserves her travel memories by (A)______ tourist spots in detail with a needle and thread, (B)______ illustration and textile design to replace traditional photo albums.
(A) (B)
choices: embroidering separating
embroidering fusing
unraveling combining
unraveling fusing
stitching separating
solution:
요약문 Teresa Lim은 삽화와 직물 디자인을 (B)융합하여 전통적인 사진첩을 대체하면서, 바늘과 실로 관광지를 상세하게 (A)수놓음으로써, 자신의 여행 추억을 독특하게 보존한다.
오답
① 수놓음 분리함
③ 풀어냄 결합함
④ 풀어냄 융합함
⑤ 꿰맴 분리함

body:
During the 2008 Beijing Olympics, 25 new swimming world records were set. At the competition, a new type of swimsuit was worn by many swimmers. It was a full body swimsuit designed with a material that imitated shark skin. The suit allowed for better oxygen flow to the muscles, reduced water resistance, and added buoyancy by trapping air. In fact, some swimmers wore two or more of these suits at once to increase buoyancy. In total, about 23 out of the 25 world records at the Beijing Olympics were set by swimmers wearing this type of suit.
In later competitions, swimmers wearing various types of innovative swimsuits continued to break world records. As a result, in 2009, FINA, the international governing body for water sports, ______. They also dictated that the fabric used to make the suits must be breathable.
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: allowed athletes to choose any swimsuit as long as it improved performance
formally permitted all athletes to wear shark-skin suits
established strict safety rules to protect swimmers
banned the use of any natural fabrics in races
decided to ban all full body swimsuits
solution:
근육 산소 공급 원활, 저항 감소, 부력 증가 등으로 선수 개인의 기록 향상에 도움이 되는 전신 수영복을 입은 수영 선수들이 계속해서 세계 기록을 깼다고 했고, 이에 대응하여 FINA가 내린 후속 조치가 빈칸에 들어가야 하므로 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 ⑤ ‘모든 전신 수영복을 금지하기로 결정했다’가 적절하다.
오답
① 경기력을 향상시키는 한 선수들이 어떤 수영복이든 선택할 수 있도록 허용했다.
② 모든 선수들이 상어 피부 수영복을 입는 것을 공식적으로 허용했다
③ 수영 선수들을 보호하기 위해 엄격한 안전 규정을 마련했다
④ 경기에서 천연 직물의 사용을 금지했다

body:
W: Hey, everyone. Welcome back to AI Talks. Today, let’s explore a fascinating subject: machine learning. You know when you use a music streaming app and it magically suggests songs you might like? Or when a camera app has those fun filters that can turn you into a movie character or place virtual sunglasses on you? That’s the magic of machine learning in action. Picture this: You have a robot, and at first, it’s nothing but a machine. Now, you show it a lot of photos of pizza. After a bit, you show it a random picture, and it can tell you if it’s pizza or not. That’s machine learning ― it’s all about helping machines learn from information. Think about your favorite game. The first time? Maybe a bit tricky. But play it again and again, and you’ll beat it, right? Machines do something similar; they learn from errors, getting smarter over time using a lot of data. And it’s not just fun and games. From healthcare to self-driving tech, machine learning is changing our world. It’s like giving computers their own set of cool skills! Stay curious, keep exploring, and until next time, happy learning!

다음 담화의 주제로 알맞은 것은?

the historical development and future challenges of machine learning
the differences between machine learning and traditional algorithms
the advantages of replacing human workers with robots in everyday life
the growing popularity of entertainment apps using artificial intelligence

body:
G: Have you heard about the latest developments in AI?
B: Yes, it’s concerning how fast technology is evolving.
G: What are you worried about?
B: Well, AI systems need an enormous amount of data, and that includes personal data. So there might be privacy concerns.
G: You’re right. I’m worried about how they will use the data without taking away our privacy.
B: The thing is, it’s not just about privacy. It’s about morality because AI can’t tell right from wrong.
G: Absolutely. There’s another issue. AI may help in healthcare, but it could give wrong diagnoses sometimes.
B: That’s worrying. Wrong diagnoses will lead to wrong treatments.
G: Definitely. It’s a tricky area with lots of things to think about.

다음 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: The rapid growth of AI technology is causing some concerns.
AI systems may raise privacy issues because they require a large amount of personal data.
The speakers agree that AI can clearly distinguish between right and wrong.
Using AI in healthcare can pose a risk of wrong diagnoses and incorrect treatments.
Both speakers are worried about the ethical and medical problems associated with AI.
solution:
소년이 AI가 옳고 그름을 구별하지 못하는 도덕성 문제가 있다고 말하자 소녀가 이에 동의한다고 답했으므로 ③ ‘두 화자는 AI가 옳고 그름을 명확하게 구별할 수 있다는 데 동의한다.‘는 일치하지 않는 내용이다.
오답
① AI 기술의 급속한 발전은 몇 가지 우려를 일으키고 있다.
② AI 시스템은 많은 양의 개인 데이터를 필요로 하기 때문에 사생활 보호 문제를 일으킬 수 있다.
④ 의료 분야에서 AI를 사용하는 것은 잘못된 진단과 잘못된 치료의 위험을 초래할 수 있다.
⑤ 두 화자는 AI와 관련된 윤리적 문제와 의료상의 문제에 대해 우려하고 있다.

body:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) ⓐhas been the subject of much discussion and controversy for many decades, with many experts predicting ⓑthat it will revolutionize our way of life. From healthcare to finance, the implementation of AI is transforming a wide range of sectors. Embracing AI ⓒmeans tapping into the potential of tomorrow in unprecedented ways. From self-driving cars to personalized medical treatments, AI is shaping our future and ⓓpushing the envelope like never before. As we stand on the brink of a new era, it is crucial ⓔwhat each of us understand the rise of AI and its impacts on our world.
AI is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as visual perception, speech recognition, decision-making, and language translation. Recent developments have also seen AI taking on more creative roles; AI art generators, for example, are able to take a human’s description in words and transform it directly into art. AI has been around for several decades, but recent advancements in computing power, data storage, and machine learning algorithms have fueled its rapid growth.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
solution:
ⓔ what → that (완전한 절(each ~ world)을 이끌어 가주어 it에 상응하는 진주어절을 이루어야 하므로 what을 명사절 접속사 that으로 고친다.)
오답
ⓐ 과거부터 지금까지 수십 년 동안 인공 지능[AI]이 많은 논의와 논란의 대상이었다는 뜻이므로 현재완료형 has been은 적절하다.
ⓑ 완전한 절(it ~ life)을 이끌어 predicting의 목적어 역할을 하는 명사절을 이루어야 하므로 명사절 접속사 that이 적절하다.
ⓒ 동명사구 주어 ‘Embracing AI’에 이어지는 동사 자리로, 동명사구 주어는 단수 취급하므로 단수동사 means는 적절하다.
ⓓ be동사 is와 함께 쓰여 현재진행형을 이루는 현재분사 shaping과 등위접속사 and로 병렬 연결되며, 주어 AI가 ‘한계를 초월하는’ 주체이므로 is와 함께 능동을 나타내는 현재분사 pushing은 적절하다.

In finance, AI algorithms ⓒare being used to automate administrative tasks, detect fraud, and make investment decisions.
Advocates of AI argue that these advancements will lead to a more efficient, productive, and technical society, ⓓwhich individuals have more time and resources to focus on more meaningful work. 2개

solution:
어법상 어색한 것은 총 2개이다.
ⓓ which → where (완전한 절(individuals ~ work)을 이끌어 콤마(,) 앞의 선행사 a more efficient, productive, and technical society를 부연 설명하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로 관계부사 where로 고친다.)
ⓔ how → that 또는 which (선행사 ways와 관계부사 how는 원래 함께 쓸 수 없을 뿐만 아니라, 여기서는 주어가 없는 불완전한 절(were previously impossible)을 이끌어 선행사 ways를 수식하는 관계사절을 이루고 있으므로, 주격 관계대명사 that 또는 which로 고친다.)

ⓒ 주어 AI algorithms이 ‘활용되는’ 대상이자, 지금 ‘활용되고 있는 중’이므로, 수동과 진행을 동시에 나타내는 수동진행형(be being p.p.)을 주어에 수일치하여 are being used로 쓴 것은 적절하다.
ⓕ 비교급 quicker를 강조 수식하는 much가 쓰인 것은 적절하다.

Some critics worry about ethical issues that are tied to AI, including its potential to maintain existing biases and discrimination. People often view computer systems as objective.
(A) As a result, in the U.S., there have been incidents where people of racial minorities have been mistakenly identified as wanted criminals by facial recognition systems and wrongfully arrested by the police.
(B) For example, facial recognition algorithms have been found to be less accurate at recognizing individuals with certain types of skin tones. This is because the algorithms were trained on data sets that mostly contained faces with lighter skin tones.
(C) However, AI systems are only as unbiased as the data they are trained on; if that data contains biases, the AI system will likely reproduce those biases in its output.
This is a valid concern, and it is important for society to take steps to diminish the potential negative impacts of AI.
In conclusion, the rise of AI is shaping the future of society in profound ways, and it is important that we consider both the potential benefits and challenges this technology presents. While AI has the potential to increase efficiency and productivity and solve complex problems, it also has the potential to cause job losses and continue existing biases. However, as with any revolutionary technology, it is likely that the rise of AI will also create new job opportunities and contribute to economic growth. ⓐAI의 개발과 활용이 신뢰할 수 있는 윤리적인 방식으로 이루어지도록 보장하는 것은 사회의 책임이다. This will require collaboration between governments, corporations, and individuals to establish regulations and standards, provide education and training programs, and ensure that the benefits of AI are shared equally. The future is now, and the way we shape the role of AI in our lives will have a profound impact on the future of humanity.

The technological singularity is the point at which ㉠______. This could lead to a future ⓐ[which / in which] humans and machines merge, creating a new form of intelligence. Either way, the technological singularity is likely to have a profound impact on the future of humanity. According to futurist Ray Kurzweil, the singularity will occur when technological development becomes unstoppable and unalterable, resulting in unanticipated changes to human civilization. Here are a few potential scenarios:
Merging with AI: We may be able to merge with AI in the future, ⓑ[enhancing / enhance] our intelligence and life expectancy. What would it be like ⓒ[to be / being] able to access the Internet with your mind? Then we might be able to think and learn at extraordinary speeds and control machines with our thoughts.
Bots taking the lead: Many traditional jobs might fade away, but exciting new roles may pop up. People might be trained to be mediators between AI and humans. Schools might teach teamwork among humans and bots rather than traditional subjects. Kids may attend “fusion schools” where AI instructor bots might collaborate with human creativity. Here, students can design artworks and invent games alongside their AI friends.
Scientific leaps: Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) can solve complex problems, allowing for phenomenal achievements in physics, medicine, climate science, and other fields at an unprecedented pace. For example, the spacecraft of the future may be capable of traveling to other planets at unimaginable speeds. They may also be equipped with advanced life support systems that will allow humans to live there for extended periods of time.
The technological singularity is a potentially dangerous event, but it is also one that could lead to incredible advances for humanity. We need to be aware of the risks and prepare for them as best we can, so that we can make sure that the singularity is a positive event for us all.

Meanwhile, many critics of AI raise concerns about its impact on employment. Automation, they argue, will lead to widespread job losses, as machines and robots replace human workers in many industries. (A)이는 실직한 이들이 이미 경쟁이 치열한 취업 시장에서 새로운 일자리를 찾느라 어려움을 겪음에 따라 증가된 빈곤과 소득 격차로 이어질 수 있다.
This argument is not without merit. Automation has already displaced workers in several industries, and it is likely that this trend will continue as AI becomes more widespread. However, it is also important to consider that automation has been a driving force behind economic growth for centuries and has consistently created new job opportunities, even as it has decreased existing ones.
For example, the rise of the automobile industry in the early 20th century led to the displacement of carriage drivers, but it also created new jobs in manufacturing, sales, and service. The same can be said for the rise of the computer industry in the late 20th century, which displaced workers in manual labor industries, but also created new jobs in software development, information technology, and related fields.

Although AI automation raises concerns about ______ ______ as it may continue to ______ human workers in various industries, history shows that technological advances ultimately drive ______ ______ and produce new ______ ______.

solution: 요약문 AI 자동화가 다양한 산업에서 인간 노동자를 계속 대체할 수 있기 때문에 실업에 대한 우려를 제기하지만, 역사는 기술 발전이 궁극적으로 경제 성장을 이끌고 새로운 취업 기회를 창출한다는 것을 보여준다.

body:
In conclusion, the rise of AI is shaping the future of society in profound ways, and it is important that we consider both the potential benefits and challenges this technology presents. While AI has the potential to increase efficiency and productivity and solve complex problems, it also has the potential to cause job losses and continue existing biases. However, as with any revolutionary technology, it is likely that the rise of AI will also create new job opportunities and contribute to economic growth. It is the responsibility of society to ensure that the development and implementation of AI are done in a responsible and ethical manner. This will require collaboration between governments, corporations, and individuals to establish regulations and standards, provide education and training programs, and ensure that the benefits of AI are shared equally. The future is now, and the way we shape the role of AI in our lives will have a profound impact on the future of humanity.

the inevitable replacement of human workers by AI technology
solution:

body:
Some critics worry about ethical issues that are tied to AI, including its potential to maintain existing biases and discrimination. People often view computer systems as objective. However, AI systems are only as unbiased as the data they are trained on; if that data contains biases, the AI system will likely ______.
For example, facial recognition algorithms have been found to be less accurate at recognizing individuals with certain types of skin tones. This is because the algorithms were trained on data sets that mostly contained faces with lighter skin tones. As a result, in the U.S., there have been incidents where people of racial minorities have been mistakenly identified as wanted criminals by facial recognition systems and wrongfully arrested by the police. This is a valid concern, and it is important for society to take steps to diminish the potential negative impacts of AI.

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: generate results that reflect the data without reproducing its biases
produce results that improve upon the information in its training data
prevent biased information from affecting its decisions
correct pre-existing biases in the data on its own
reflect the same biases in its generated results
solution:
앞에서 AI 시스템은 자신이 훈련된 데이터가 편향되지 않은 만큼만 편향되지 않게 된다고 설명하고 있으며, 뒤의 예시에서는 편향된 데이터, 즉 밝은 피부색의 얼굴이 주로 포함된 데이터로 학습한 얼굴 인식 알고리즘이 특정 피부색을 인식할 때 정확성이 떨어져 소수 인종의 사람들을 잘못 식별하여 잘못된 체포로 이어진 사례를 제시하고 있으므로 데이터에 편향이 있다면 AI 시스템이 그 편향을 산출물에 재현한다는 내용이 와야 한다. 따라서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 ⑤ ‘생성된 결과에 동일한 편향을 반영한다’가 적절하다.
본문변형 reproduce those biases in its output → reflect the same biases in its generated results
오답
① 편향을 재현하지 않으면서 데이터를 반영하는 결과를 생성한다
② 학습 데이터의 정보를 개선한 결과를 산출한다
③ 편향된 정보가 자신의 결정에 영향을 미치는 것을 막는다
④ 데이터에 이미 존재하는 편향을 스스로 수정한다

body:
AI is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as visual perception, speech recognition, decision-making, and language translation. Recent developments have also seen AI taking on more (A)[repetitive / innovative] roles; AI art generators, for example, are able to take a human’s description in words and transform it directly into art. AI has been around for several decades, but recent advancements in computing power, data storage, and machine learning algorithms have (B)[boosted / hindered] its rapid growth.
Some of the most significant impacts of AI are increased efficiency and productivity. Through automation, AI systems and robots can perform repetitive, boring, and dangerous tasks easily, (C)[allowing / forbidding] humans to focus on more innovative and strategic work. In the healthcare sector, AI is being used to analyze vast amounts of medical data to improve diagnoses. In finance, AI algorithms are being used to automate administrative tasks, detect fraud, and make investment decisions.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: innovative boosted forbidding
repetitive hindered allowing
repetitive boosted forbidding
innovative boosted allowing
innovative hindered allowing
solution:
(A) 뒤에서 AI 미술 작품 생성기는 인간이 말로 묘사한 내용을 가지고 바로 미술 작품으로 변환할 수 있다고 했으므로 AI가 단순한 작업을 넘어 창의적인 영역까지 맡는다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 innovative(혁신적인, 창의적인)이 적절하다.
본문변형 creative → innovative
repetitive 반복적인
(B) 앞에서 AI가 수십 년 동안 존재해 왔지만, 최근 연산력, 데이터 저장, 머신 러닝 알고리즘의 발전을 바탕으로 빠르게 성장했다고 설명하고 있으므로, 이러한 발전이 AI의 성장을 촉진했다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 boosted(증진했다)가 적절하다.
hinder ~을 방해하다
본문변형 fueled → boosted
(C) 앞에서 AI 시스템과 로봇이 반복적이고, 지루하며, 위험한 작업을 대신 수행한다고 했으므로, 인간은 보다 더 혁신적이고 전략적인 업무에 집중할 수 있다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 allowing(가능하게 하는)이 적절하다.
본문변형 freeing up → allowing
forbid ~을 못 하게 하다

body:
Meanwhile, many critics of AI raise concerns about its impact on employment. Automation, they argue, will lead to widespread job losses, as machines and robots replace human workers in many industries. This could lead to increased poverty and income gap, as those who lose their jobs struggle to find new employment in an already competitive job market.
This argument is not without merit. Automation has already displaced workers in several industries, and it is likely (A)[what / that] this trend will continue as AI becomes more ⓐwidespread. However, (B)[what / it] is also important to consider that automation has been a ⓑdriving force behind economic growth for centuries and has consistently created new job opportunities, even as it has decreased existing ones.
For example, the rise of the automobile industry in the early 20th century led to the displacement of carriage drivers, but it also created new jobs in manufacturing, sales, and service. The same can be said for the rise of the computer industry in the late 20th century, (C)[which / that] displaced workers in manual labor industries, but also created new jobs in software development, information technology, and related fields.
Therefore, it is ⓒunlikely that the rise of AI will also give rise to new job opportunities. There will be a growing demand for data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI ethics experts, among others. These jobs will allow individuals to contribute to society in meaningful ways. At the same time, since they require new skills, education and training will need to ⓓevolve to help people prepare for these new opportunities. By adapting and learning, people can find paths in a world where AI plays a ⓔmajor role.

solution: ⓒ unlikely(~할 것 같지 않은) → likely(~할 것 같은)

body:
It is said that silk production began with the most Chinese of things: tea. Leizu, the young wife of the Yellow Emperor, was sitting under a tree, with a cup of tea in her hand. A cocoon fell from one of the branches directly into the cup. ⓐ당연히 그녀는 그 불쾌한 물체를 건져 냈고, 그녀는 놀랍게도 그 차가 고치의 막을 녹였다는 것을 알게 되었다. What she held was a little lump of soft fibers. Leizu unraveled it until it stretched from end to end of her garden, over 600 meters. Intrigued, she gathered more cocoons from the tree to unravel, and worked the threads into cloth. The result was a soft and shiny fabric that was cool to the touch. This Chinese legend is only one of many woven around the production of silk.
For a long time, silk was a material reserved for the Emperor and those very close to him. Gradually, the restrictions on who could wear and use silk were eased, and more and more people could be seen to wear silk clothing and to dress up their homes with silk decorations. Eventually, silk production grew to become quite a large industry in China.

윗글의 내용과 (A)~(E)가 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓸 때, 순서대로 연결된 것은?
(A) Silk production is believed to have started when a cocoon accidentally fell into Leizu’s cup of tea. (T/F)
(B) After discovering a lump of soft fibers, Leizu unwound it into a thread more than 600 meters long. (T/F)
(C) The fabric made from silk was smooth and shiny, while also feeling cool when touched. (T/F)
(D) At first, silk was widely available to ordinary people, but its use was later limited to the Emperor and his close associates. (T/F)
(E) Silk clothing and decorations became less common among Chinese people. (T/F)
choices: F-T-T-T-F
F-T-T-F-F
T-T-T-F-F
T-F-T-T-F
T-T-T-T-F
solution:
차례대로 T-T-T-F-F이다.
(A) 비단 생산은 고치 하나가 우연히 Leizu의 찻잔에 떨어지면서 시작된 것으로 여겨진다. (일치)
(B) 부드러운 섬유 덩어리를 발견한 후, Leizu는 그것을 풀어 600미터가 넘는 길이의 실로 만들었다. (일치)
(C) 비단으로 만들어진 직물은 매끄럽고 반짝였으며, 만졌을 때 시원한 느낌이 났다. (일치)
(D) 처음에는(→나중에는) 비단이 일반 사람들에게 널리 이용 가능했지만, 나중에는(→처음에는) 그것의 사용이 황제와 그의 가까운 사람들에게만 제한되었다. (불일치)
(E) 비단으로 만든 옷과 장식품은 중국인들 사이에서 덜(→더) 흔해졌다. (불일치)

On July 21, 1969, 528 million people tuned in to watch the first human impression on the surface of the moon. Apollo 11 was the first space mission ⓐto take humans to the moon. One of the greatest challenges for this achievement involved manufacturing a space suit that could protect the astronauts: it would need to provide the astronauts with adequate air pressure and ⓑbe able to withstand extreme temperatures ─ a maximum of 150°C in direct sunlight and a minimum of -233°C. However, such a technology did not exist in 1969.
Eight companies presented their solutions to NASA. To everyone’s surprise, the company ⓒwhich won the contract for the Apollo suits wasn’t as big as the others and owed its reputation to its product line of female underwear.
(A) Their skills were acquired from years of making women’s underwear. ⓓWhat made the work so hard was the number of layers and components involved.
(B) The company came up with a softer and more flexible space suit ⓔmaking almost entirely of fabric. Each suit was made by seamstresses using their hands and sewing machines.
(C) In the end, each suit worn on the moon was comprised of some four thousand pieces of fabric and twenty-one layers of distinct materials, weighing 72 kg at the time.
It remains the most complex space suit to have been used to date, and it was the fruit of the craftsmanship of the women skilled in sewing and making underwear, rather than NASA’s technological expertise.

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: NASA에 솔루션을 제안한 8개사 중, 아폴로 우주복 계약을 따낸 곳은 다른 업체만큼 크지도 않은 여성 속옷으로 명성을 얻은 업체였다는 주어진 글 뒤에, 이 회사를 The company로 이어받아, 이 회사가 개발한 우주복의 특징(직물로 만들어진 더 부드럽고 유연한 우주복)을 소개하는 (B), (B)에서 언급한 여자 재봉사들(seamstresses)을 Their로 받아 이들의 기술이 여성 속옷을 만들면서 습득한 것임을 설명하는 (A), (A)의 마지막 문장에서 관련된 층과 구성 요소의 수 때문에 우주복 제작 작업이 매우 어려웠다고 언급한 뒤 우주복이 실제로 얼마나 복잡하게 만들어졌는지 구체적인 수치를 제시하는 (C)로 이어지는 흐름이 자연스럽다.

body:
For a long time, silk was a material reserved for the Emperor and those very close to him. Gradually, the restrictions on who could wear and use silk were (A)[eased / tightened], and more and more people could be seen to wear silk clothing and to dress up their homes with silk decorations. Eventually, silk production grew to become quite a large industry in China.
Silk became a valuable commodity highly sought after by other countries at a very early time, and it is believed that the silk trade was actually started before the Silk Road was officially opened in the second century B.C. The threads of silk found in the hair of an Egyptian mummy from around 1070 B.C. are probably the (B)[earliest / latest] evidence of the silk trade. The Silk Road significantly shaped the societies and cultures of the regions that it connected. Not only silk, but spices, rare metals, and exotic animals were also exchanged on the road. Religions, artistic styles, and technologies were shared as well, (C)[prompting / hindering] the development of the civilizations.

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
(A) (B) (C)
choices: tightened / earliest / prompting
eased / latest / prompting
eased / earliest / hindering
tightened / after / hindering
eased / earliest / prompting
solution:
(A) 뒤에서 점점 더 많은 사람들이 비단옷을 입고 집을 비단 장식으로 꾸미는 것이 보이게 되었다고 했으므로 비단의 사용 제한이 느슨해졌다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 eased(느슨해진)가 적절하다.
tighten (규정∙법 등)을 강화하다
(B) 비단 교역은 실크로드가 기원전 2세기에 공식적으로 열리기 이전에 실제로 시작된 것으로 여겨지므로, 기원전 1070년경의 이집트 미라의 머리카락에서 비단실이 발견된 것은 비단 교역의 ‘최초의’ 증거라는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 earliest(최초의)가 적절하다.
latest 최근의
(C) 실크로드를 통해 비단뿐만 아니라 향신료, 희귀 금속, 이국적인 동물들 그리고 종교, 예술 양식, 기술까지도 공유되었다고 했으므로 문명의 발달을 촉진했다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 prompting(~을 촉진하는)이 적절하다.
hinder 방해하다

body:
Technology Doping
During the 2008 Beijing Olympics, 25 new swimming world records were set. At the competition, a new type of swimsuit was worn by many swimmers. It was a full body swimsuit designed with a material ⓐwhat imitated shark skin. The suit allowed for better oxygen flow to the muscles, reduced water resistance, and added buoyancy by trapping air. In fact, some swimmers wore two or more of these suits at once ⓑto increase buoyancy. In total, about 23 out of the 25 world records at the Beijing Olympics were set by swimmers wearing this type of suit.
In later competitions, swimmers ⓒwearing various types of innovative swimsuits continued to break world records. (A)______, in 2009, FINA, the international governing body for water sports, decided to ban all full body swimsuits. They also dictated that the fabric used ⓓto make the suits must be breathable.
“Technology doping” in sports means the practice of gaining a competitive edge by using technology to improve performance. This can be against the spirit of fair play. (B)______, since most sports require equipment of some sort, ⓔit can be tricky to determine what is technology doping and what is not. Some argue that it is a natural progress coming from scientific development, while others claim it undermines human spirit and effort, ensuring that rich athletes have an advantage over poor ones.

윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?
solution:
ⓐ what → that (주어가 없는 불완전한 절(imitated shark skin)을 이끌어 선행사 a material을 수식하는 관계사절을 이루어야 하므로 what을 주격 관계대명사 that으로 고친다.)
오답
ⓑ 완전한 절(some ~ once)에 접속사 없이 이어져 ‘부력을 늘리기 위해’라는 뜻으로 쓰였으므로 목적의 의미를 갖는 부사적 용법의 to부정사 to increase는 적절하다.
ⓒ 명사 swimmers를 수식하는 분사 자리이며, swimmers가 수영복을 ‘입는’ 주체이므로 능동의 의미를 갖는 현재분사 wearing은 적절하다.
ⓓ 완전한 절(They ~ used)에 접속사 없이 이어져 ‘만들기 위해’라는 뜻으로 쓰였으므로 목적의 의미를 갖는 부사적 용법의 to부정사 to make는 적절하다.
ⓔ 주격보어 tricky 뒤에 이어지는 진주어 to determine에 상응하는 가주어 자리이므로 it은 적절하다.

body:
Teresa Lim, Embroidery Art
People usually take pictures of scenic views, but Teresa Lim paints pictures of tourist spots with a needle and thread when she travels the world. She embroiders places she visits in surprising detail. This method of preserving memories ⓐlet her truly take in her surroundings. She spends time sitting in one place, observing details and ⓑstitching as the scene reveals itself. She says on her website ⓒwhere her designs “seek to erase the lines and boundaries between being an illustrator and a textile designer.” Her art is a delightful fusion of a canvas and a camera that ⓓprojects travel scenes onto fabric. She recreates ⓔwhat she sees on cloth and eliminates the need for a vacation photo album.

윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: Teresa Lim creates images of places with embroidery instead of taking photographs.
Teresa Lim carefully observes the places she visits while sewing their details onto fabric.
Spending time in one spot allows Teresa Lim to pay closer attention to the surrounding scenery.
Teresa Lim keeps illustration and textile design separate rather than combining the two forms of art.
Teresa Lim’s artwork combines the qualities of a painting and a photograph to show travel scenes on cloth.
solution:

⑤ Teresa Lim의 작품은 여행 장면을 천 위에 보여 주기 위해 그림과 사진의 특성들을 결합한다.

body:
Cloth That Connected the Worlds
It is said that silk production began with the most Chinese of things: tea. Leizu, the young wife of the Yellow Emperor, was sitting under a tree, with a cup of tea in her hand. A cocoon fell from one of the branches directly into the cup. Naturally, she fished the offending object out, and to her amazement, she found that the tea had dissolved the coating of the cocoon. What she held was a little lump of soft fibers. Leizu unraveled it until it stretched from end to end of her garden, over 600 meters. Intrigued, she gathered more cocoons from the tree to unravel, and worked the threads into cloth. The result was a soft and shiny fabric that was cool to the touch. This Chinese legend is only one of many woven around the production of silk.
For a long time, silk was a material reserved for the Emperor and those very close to him. Gradually, the restrictions on who could wear and use silk were eased, and more and more people could be seen to wear silk clothing and to dress up their homes with silk decorations. Eventually, silk production grew to become quite a large industry in China.
Silk became a valuable commodity highly sought after by other countries at a very early time, and it is believed that the silk trade was actually started before the Silk Road was officially opened in the second century B.C. The threads of silk found in the hair of an Egyptian mummy from around 1070 B.C. are probably the earliest evidence of the silk trade. The Silk Road significantly shaped the societies and cultures of the regions that it connected. Not only silk, but spices, rare metals, and exotic animals were also exchanged on the road. Religions, artistic styles, and technologies were shared as well, ______.

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: making China fall behind other countries culturally
prompting the development of the civilizations
accelerating the isolation of Eastern empires
helping people preserve their local religions
leading to the monopoly of silk production
solution:
빈칸 앞에서 실크로드를 통해 비단뿐만 아니라 향신료, 희귀 금속, 이국적인 동물이 교환되고 종교, 예술 양식, 기술이 공유되었다고 설명하고 있으므로, 이러한 다양한 물질적·문화적 교류의 결과로 문명의 발전이 촉진되었다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 ② ‘문명들의 발전을 촉진했다’가 적절하다.
오답
① 중국이 문화적으로 다른 나라들에 뒤처지게 만들다
③ 동방 제국들의 고립을 가속했다
④ 사람들이 자신들의 지역 종교를 보존하도록 도왔다
⑤ 비단 생산의 독점으로 이어졌다

AI is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as visual perception, speech recognition, decision-making, and language translation. body:
Some critics worry about ethical issues that are tied to AI, including its potential to ______. People often view computer systems as objective. However, AI systems are only as unbiased as the data they are trained on; if that data contains biases, the AI system will likely reproduce those biases in its output.
For example, facial recognition algorithms have been found to be less accurate at recognizing individuals with certain types of skin tones. This is because the algorithms were trained on data sets that mostly contained faces with lighter skin tones. As a result, in the U.S., there have been incidents where people of racial minorities have been mistakenly identified as wanted criminals by facial recognition systems and wrongfully arrested by the police. This is a valid concern, and it is important for society to take steps to diminish the potential negative impacts of AI.

choices: eliminate human errors in data processing
maintain existing biases and discrimination

reduce the dependence on human intelligence
cause widespread job losses through excessive automation

body:
Some critics worry about ethical issues that are tied to AI, including its potential to (A)[eliminate / maintain] existing biases and discrimination. People often view computer systems as objective. However, AI systems are only as unbiased as the data they are trained on; if that data contains biases, the AI system will likely reproduce those biases in its output.
For example, facial recognition algorithms have been found to be less accurate at recognizing individuals with certain types of skin tones. This is because the algorithms were trained on data sets that mostly contained faces with lighter skin tones. As a result, in the U.S., there have been incidents where people of racial minorities have been mistakenly identified as wanted criminals by facial recognition systems and (B)[rightfully / wrongfully] arrested by the police. This is a valid concern, and it is important for society to take steps to diminish the potential negative impacts of AI.
In conclusion, the rise of AI is shaping the future of society in profound ways, and it is important that we consider both the potential benefits and challenges this technology presents. While AI has the potential to increase efficiency and productivity and solve complex problems, it also has the potential to cause job losses and (C)[cease / continue] existing biases. However, as with any revolutionary technology, it is likely that the rise of AI will also create new job opportunities and contribute to economic growth. It is the responsibility of society to ensure that the development and implementation of AI are done in a responsible and ethical manner. This will require collaboration between governments, corporations, and individuals to establish regulations and standards, provide education and training programs, and ensure that the benefits of AI are shared equally. The future is now, and the way we shape the role of AI in our lives will have a profound impact on the future of humanity.
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 흐름상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: eliminate rightfully cease
maintain rightfully continue
eliminate wrongfully continue
maintain wrongfully cease
maintain wrongfully continue
solution:
(A) 뒤에서 AI가 훈련된 데이터에 편견이 포함되어 있으면 그 편견을 결과에 재현할 수 있다고 했으므로 기존의 편향과 차별을 그대로 가지고 있다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 maintain(지속시키다)이 적절하다.
eliminate 제거하다
(B) 앞에서 안면 인식 알고리즘이 특정 피부색에 대해 낮은 정확도를 보였으며, 그 원인이 밝은 피부색의 얼굴이 주로 포함된 데이터로 학습되었기 때문으로, 미국에서 소수 인종 사람들이 안면 인식 시스템에 의해 수배 중인 범죄자로 잘못 식별되어 경찰에 체포된 사례를 제시하고 있으므로, 실제로 범죄를 저지르지 않은 사람들이 부당하게 체포됐다는 흐름이 자연스럽다. 따라서 wrongfully(부당하게)가 적절하다.
rightfully 정당하게
(C) AI가 효율성과 생산성을 높이고 복잡한 문제를 해결할 가능성이 있지만, 실업을 야기할 가능성이 있다고 했으므로 이와 같은 맥락으로 AI로 인한 부정적인 측면이 언급되어야 한다. 따라서 기존의 편향을 지속시킨다는 흐름의 continue(지속시키다)가 적절하다.
cease ~을 중단하다

위 주어진 글에 이어질 순서로 알맞은 것은?
solution: AI를 비판하는 이들이 AI의 자동화로 인해 일자리가 감소하고, 이것이 빈곤과 소득 격차의 확대로 이어질 수 있다고 주장하는 주어진 글 뒤에, 이러한 주장을 This argument(이 주장)로 이어받아 일리가 있음을 인정하고 실제로 여러 산업에서 근로자가 대체되어 왔다고 언급하는 (B), However(그러나)로 시작하여 (B)에서 설명한 자동화의 부정적인 측면과 대조적으로, 자동화가 기존 일자리를 감소시키기도 했지만 수백 년 동안 경제 성장의 원동력이었으며 새로운 일자리도 지속적으로 만들어 왔다는 점을 설명하는 (A), For example(예를 들어)로 시작하여 앞에서 제시한 자동화가 기존 일자리를 감소시켰으나 새로운 일자리를 만들어 왔다는 내용을 뒷받침하는 구체적인 사례로, 자동차 산업의 발전으로 마차 운전사들은 일자리를 잃었지만 제조, 판매, 서비스 분야에서는 새로운 일자리가 생겼다는 점을 제시하는 (C)로 이어지는 흐름이 자연스럽다.

In conclusion, the rise of AI is shaping the future of society in profound ways, and it is important that we consider both the potential benefits and challenges this technology presents. While AI has the potential to increase efficiency and productivity and solve complex problems, it also has the potential to cause job losses and continue existing biases. However, as with any revolutionary technology, it is likely that the rise of AI will also create new job opportunities and contribute to economic growth. It is the responsibility of society to ensure that the development and implementation of AI are done in a responsible and ethical manner. This will require collaboration between governments, corporations, and individuals to establish regulations and standards, provide education and training programs, and ensure that the benefits of AI are shared equally. The future is now, and the way we shape the role of AI in our lives will have a profound impact on the future of humanity.

The technological singularity is the point at which Artificial Intelligence will ⓐexceed human intelligence. This (A)could lead to a future in which machines can create their own technology, and humans may become useless. Alternatively, the technological singularity could lead to a future in which humans and machines merge, creating a new form of intelligence. Either way, the technological singularity is likely to have a ⓑprofound impact on the future of humanity. According to futurist Ray Kurzweil, the singularity will occur when technological development becomes unstoppable and unalterable, resulting in ⓒanticipated changes to human civilization. Here are a few potential scenarios:
Merging with AI: We may be able to merge with AI in the future, enhancing our intelligence and life expectancy. What would it be like to be able to access the Internet with your mind? Then we might be able to think and learn at extraordinary speeds and control machines with our thoughts.
Bots taking the lead: Many traditional jobs might ⓓfade away, but exciting new roles may pop up. People might be trained to be mediators between AI and humans. Schools might teach teamwork among humans and bots rather than traditional subjects. Kids may attend “fusion schools” (B)where AI instructor bots might collaborate with human creativity. Here, students can design artworks and invent games alongside their AI friends.
Scientific leaps: Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) can solve complex problems, (C)allow for phenomenal achievements in physics, medicine, climate science, and other fields at an ⓔunprecedented pace. For example, the spacecraft of the future may be capable of traveling to other planets at unimaginable speeds. They may also be equipped with advanced life support systems that will allow humans (D)to live there for extended periods of time.
The technological singularity is a potentially dangerous event, but it is also one (E)that could lead to incredible advances for humanity. We need to be aware of the risks and prepare for them as best we can, so that we can make sure (F)what the singularity is a positive event for us all.

body:
Therefore, it is likely that the rise of AI will also give rise to new job opportunities. There will be a growing demand for data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI ethics experts, among others. These jobs will allow individuals to contribute to society in meaningful ways. At the same time, since they require new skills, education and training will need to evolve to help people prepare for these new opportunities. By adapting and learning, people can find paths in a world where AI plays a major role.
Some critics worry about ethical issues that are tied to AI, including its potential to maintain existing biases and discrimination. People often view computer systems as objective. However, AI systems are only as unbiased as the data they are trained on; if that data contains biases, the AI system will likely reproduce those biases in its output.
For example, facial recognition algorithms have been found to ______. This is because the algorithms were trained on data sets that mostly contained faces with lighter skin tones. As a result, in the U.S., there have been incidents where people of racial minorities have been mistakenly identified as wanted criminals by facial recognition systems and wrongfully arrested by the police. This is a valid concern, and it is important for society to take steps to diminish the potential negative impacts of AI.

윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
choices: perform equally well regardless of people’s skin tones
be free from the biases contained in their training data
be less accurate at recognizing individuals with certain types of skin tones
correct the unfair judgments that people tend to make based on skin color
produce inaccurate results mainly because they process an excessive amount of facial data
solution:
앞에서 AI 시스템은 자신이 훈련된 데이터에 편향이 포함되어 있을 경우 그 편향을 결과에 재현할 수 있다고 설명했으며, 그 예시로 언급된 안면 인식 알고리즘은 밝은 피부색의 얼굴 위주인 데이터로 학습되어 그 결과 소수 인종이 범죄자로 잘못 식별되어 부당하게 체포되었다는 내용이 이어지므로, 빈칸에는 안면 인식 알고리즘이 밝은 피부색이 아닌 다른 피부색을 가진 사람들을 식별할 때 덜 정확하다는 내용이 들어가야 한다. 따라서 ③ ‘특정 유형의 피부색을 가진 사람들을 인식할 때 정확성이 떨어진다’가 빈칸에 들어가야 한다.
오답
① 사람들의 피부색과 관계없이 똑같이 잘 작동하다
② 훈련 데이터에 포함된 편향에서 자유롭다[영향을 받지 않는다]
④ 사람들이 피부색을 바탕으로 흔히 내리는 불공정한 판단을 바로잡다
⑤ 주로 지나치게 많은 양의 얼굴 데이터를 처리하기 때문에 부정확한 결과를 만들어 내다

body:
However, it is also important to consider that automation has been a driving force behind economic growth for centuries and has consistently created new job opportunities, even as it has decreased existing ones.

Meanwhile, many critics of AI raise concerns about its impact on employment. Automation, they argue, will lead to widespread job losses, as machines and robots replace human workers in many industries. (A) This could lead to increased poverty and income gap, as those who lose their jobs struggle to find new employment in an already competitive job market. (B) This argument is not without merit. (C) Automation has already displaced workers in several industries, and it is likely that this trend will continue as AI becomes more widespread. (D)
For example, the rise of the automobile industry in the early 20th century led to the displacement of carriage drivers, but it also created new jobs in manufacturing, sales, and service. (E) The same can be said for the rise of the computer industry in the late 20th century, which displaced workers in manual labor industries, but also created new jobs in software development, information technology, and related fields.

다음 글의 (A)~(E) 중, 주어진 문장이 들어갈 알맞은 곳은?
solution: 주어진 문장은 ‘그러나, 자동화는 수백 년간 경제 성장의 원동력이었고, 기존의 취업 기회를 감소시키는 한편 지속적으로 새로운 취업 기회를 창출해 왔다는 점을 고려하는 것 또한 중요하다.’라는 뜻으로, However(그러나)로 시작하며 ‘it is also important to consider that(~라는 점을 고려하는 것 또한 중요하다)’라고 했으므로 자동화의 긍정적인 측면을 제시하기에 앞서 자동화의 부정적인 영향이나 우려가 언급되어야 한다. (D) 앞에서 자동화가 이미 여러 산업에서 근로자를 대체했으며, 이러한 추세가 계속될 가능성이 있다는 부정적인 영향을 언급하고 있다. 또한 (D) 뒤에서 For example(예를 들어)로 시작하여 자동차 산업의 발전이 마차 운전사의 일자리를 감소시킨 동시에 제조, 판매, 서비스 분야에서 새로운 일자리를 창출한 구체적인 사례를 제시하고 있다. 따라서 앞의 부정적인 영향과 뒤의 구체적인 사례를 자연스럽게 연결하도록 주어진 문장이 (D)에 들어가는 것이 적절하다.

body:
AI is the ability of computers and machines (A)[perform / to perform] tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as visual perception, speech recognition, decision-making, and language translation. Recent developments have also seen AI (B)[taking / to take] on more creative roles; AI art generators, for example, are able to take a human’s description in words and transform it directly into art. AI has been around for several decades, but recent advancements in computing power, data storage, and machine learning algorithms have fueled its rapid growth.
Some of the most significant impacts of AI (C)[is / are] increased efficiency and productivity. Through automation, AI systems and robots can perform repetitive, boring, and dangerous tasks easily, freeing up humans to focus on more innovative and strategic work. In the healthcare sector, AI is being used to analyze vast amounts of medical data to improve diagnoses. In finance, AI algorithms are being used to automate administrative tasks, detect fraud, and make investment decisions.
Advocates of AI argue that these advancements will lead to a more efficient, productive, and technical society, where individuals have more time and resources to focus on more meaningful work. They also argue that AI has the potential to solve complex problems, such as climate change and disease, in ways that were previously impossible. For example, AI can analyze huge amounts of data quickly to find patterns in weather changes or the spread of a disease. This could lead to finding solutions to climate change and cures for untreatable illnesses much quicker.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?
choices: perform / to take / is
to perform / to take / are
perform / taking / are
to perform / taking / is
to perform / taking / are
solution:
(A) ‘수행하는 (능력)’이라는 뜻으로 명사구 the ability를 수식하므로 형용사적 용법의 to부정사 to perform이 적절하다.
(B) have also seen의 목적격보어 자리로, 지각동사 see는 ’see+목적어+목적격보어’의 5형식 구문으로 쓰이며 목적어와 목적격보어가 능동 관계일 때 목적격보어로 동사원형 또는 –ing(현재분사)를 쓰고, 수동 관계일 때 목적격보어로 p.p.(과거분사)를 쓴다. 여기서는 AI가 보다 창의적인 역할을 맡는 주체이므로 능동의 의미를 지닌 현재분사 taking이 적절하다.
(C) 주어의 핵이 impacts이며 복수명사이므로 이에 수일치한 복수동사 are가 적절하다.

solution:
차례대로 T-T-T-T-F이다.
(A) AI 기반 도구는 한 사람의 글로 작성된 아이디어를 시각적인 예술 작품으로 바꿀 수 있다. (일치)
(B) 반복적이고 위험한 업무를 기계에 맡기는 것은 사람들이 창의적인 일에 시간을 쓸 수 있게 할 수 있다. (일치)
(C) AI의 지지자들은 기술의 발전이 사람들에게 더 많은 시간과 자원을 의미 있는 활동에 사용할 수 있게 할 것으로 예상한다. (일치)
(D) AI는 기후 변화에 대한 더 빠른 해결책과 현재 치료할 수 없는 질병에 대한 치료법에 기여할 수 있다. (일치)
(E) 대량의 정보를 처리하는 데 상당한 시간이 걸리기 때문에, AI는 기후 변화와 질병에 대처하려는 노력을 늦출 수 있다.(→AI는 날씨 변화의 양상을 찾기 위해 엄청난 양의 데이터를 빠르게 분석할 수 있다.) (불일치)
